Journal article has been submitted to Nonprofit and Voluntary Sector Quarterly (https://journals.sagepub.com/home/NVS)

This study has been reviewed and received ethics clearance through a University of Waterloo Research Ethics Board (REB #43278).
This dataset contains the anonymized results of an online survey of volunteers in Ontario conservation and ecological restoration projects conducted in 2021.
